response.overview: Hello people. This is the first ever Keeshlife movie, filmed in the season 2015-2016  in the cold streets of Finland with a little flavor from Ruka and  Riksgränsen. We went out there with our handycams and whatever cameras we were able to get our hands into and filmed each others like a bunch of friends do. Only plan was to make a movie out of it. That went on for over 60 days during the winter. Cant tell you much about the skiing before you watch it.
response.title: Keeshlife Movie
